svg.text: Pico W + TB6600 Y + BTT TMC2226 dual Z
Active Y uses the dedicated y_pico/TMC5160 adapter; its physical endstop is on y_pico GPIO4.
The primary Pico TB6600-style interface remains reserved: STEP=GPIO0, DIR=GPIO1, EN=GPIO2.
The legacy primary-Pico Y-endstop header is repurposed for multi-head-zero: NC signal=GPIO4, COM=GND.
Its third header pin remains connected to 3.3V but is unused; do not connect it to the dry-contact switch.
TMC1 is reserved as the Y fallback: STEP=GPIO11, DIR=GPIO10, EN=GPIO12, UART=GPIO9.
TMC1 fallback DIAG: TMC top DIAG pad to GPIO3 through 1.2k series resistor.
Live Y motor phases are on the dedicated TMC5160 driver; the local TMC1 motor wiring is reserved for rollback.
Heatbed SSR: SSR_OUT=GPIO20 with Pico logic ground for the single 220V 750W bed.
Reserved MOSFET driver: HEATBED_ON=GPIO21 remains wired but has no active Klipper assignment.
Heatbed thermistor: SIGNAL=GPIO26_ADC0, GND=AGND, 4.7k pull-up REF-to-SIGNAL.
Heatbed thermistor damping: 100uF SIGNAL-to-GND; electrolytic positive to SIGNAL, negative to AGND/GND.
Vision APA102 helper header: 5V=VBUS for small-strip test use, 3.3V=level-shifter LV reference,
GND=common ground, CLOCK=GPIO18, DATA=GPIO19. Shifted outputs go to strip CI/DI input side.
Nine APA102 pixels at full white may approach USB-test power limits; use fused external 5V if unstable.
